blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—A suspicious parcel reported by two delivery riders in Marikina City was found to contain an estimated P150,000 worth of illegal drugs, prompting the Philippine National Police (PNP) to step up its coordination with ride-hailing firms. In a statement on Monday, PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. urged riders to remain vigilant and immediately report suspicious activities through provided emergency hotlines. “We likewise ask them to be extra vigilant and more discerning when handling suspicious packages. It’s better to report this to police authorities if there are doubts,” Nartatez said. Nartatez Jr. said they will coordinate with ride-hailing companies […]...
